messages.author: 6ad178c9bfa534b7
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Auxiliary particle filter
parts: No, since Stan does not draw samples like in APF. Stan primarily uses Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for sampling from the posterior distribution, so it would be an alternative algorithm for sampling from an nonlinear state space model.
